description: Header file defining classes and functions for managing Dispmanx display resources, rectangles, and video rendering on Raspberry Pi using the Dispmanx API.

classes.name: DispmanxRect
classes.description: Represents a rectangle for Dispmanx operations, with constructors to initialize rectangle dimensions.

classes.name: DispmanxDisplay
classes.description: Manages a Dispmanx display, handling initialization and cleanup.

classes.name: DispmanxResource
classes.description: Base class for Dispmanx image resources, managing resource handle and dimensions.

classes.name: DispmanxYUV420Resource
classes.description: Derived from DispmanxResource, manages YUV420 image data.

classes.name: DispmanxRGB565Resource
classes.description: Derived from DispmanxResource, manages RGB565 image data.

classes.name: DispmanxElement
classes.description: Represents a Dispmanx element, allowing source changes.

classes.name: DispmanxVideoFrame
classes.description: Represents a video frame with associated Dispmanx resource and release callback.

classes.name: DispmanxVideoRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of video frames onto a Dispmanx display.

methods.name: DispmanxRect()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing rectangle to zero.

methods.name: DispmanxRect(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
methods.description: Constructor initializing rectangle with specified position and size.

methods.name: DispmanxDisplay()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the display, opening Dispmanx display handle.

methods.name: ~DispmanxDisplay()
methods.description: Destructor closing display handle and deinitializing host.

methods.name: DispmanxResource(VC_IMAGE_TYPE_T image_type, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t visible_width, uint32_t visible_height)
methods.description: Protected constructor for creating a Dispmanx resource with specified image type and dimensions.

methods.name: WriteData(const void* data)
methods.description: Writes data to the YUV420 resource.

methods.name: ClearWithBlack()
methods.description: Clears the resource with black color.

methods.name: DispmanxElement(const DispmanxDisplay& display, int32_t layer, const DispmanxRect& dest_rect, const DispmanxResource& src, const DispmanxRect& src_rect)
methods.description: Constructor creating a Dispmanx element with specified parameters.

methods.name: ChangeSource(const DispmanxResource& new_src)
methods.description: Changes the source resource of the element.

methods.name: DispmanxVideoFrame(int64_t time, DispmanxYUV420Resource* resource, std::function<void(DispmanxYUV420Resource*)> release_cb)
methods.description: Constructor for a video frame with timestamp, resource, and release callback.

methods.name: ~DispmanxVideoFrame()
methods.description: Destructor that calls the release callback.

methods.name: Update(const scoped_refptr<VideoFrame>& video_frame)
methods.description: Updates the renderer with a new video frame.
